Yes. First thing in the morning, everyone drinks it. Even the kids. Because water could easily
kill you faster than a sword. Rivers and wells were full of parasites, animal waste, diarrhea,
and whatever the town dumped upstream. Beer was safer because the brewing process involved boiling
the liquid and fermenting it, which killed most of the dangerous bacteria. And it wasn't strong
beer like today. Most people drank small beer. A very weak version with very low alcohol that
you could drink all day without getting drunk. About 20 minutes after breakfast, your stomach
suddenly decides to start a revolution. Not a cute stomach ache. Not oof. I feel a bit bloated.
A deep, twisting pain hits you like a spear from the inside, and you instantly know something in
that stew was not meant for human consumption. And just like that, you need to go. Now.
